reuse: Paused two-character inventory UI, action ordering, default-no delete, flag-preserving transfers and bulk operations adapted in app/item_editor.hpp. Unmodified local source retained for attribution and comparison; local file modifications relative to HEAD unconfirmed.
dependencies: The retained Gambatte adapter is reference-only and not compiled. Runtime uses the existing binjnes core (MIT), SDL3 (zlib), WizEdit save repair (MIT). No new emulator dependency.
compatibility: FC I Mapper 1, FC II/III Mapper 4; C++20 Windows x64 and Android arm64-v8a. GB/GBC record offsets and Gambatte API are not used.
